rationale: Base station is online with uplink OK, but logs show repeated E-503 "cloud report failed: TLS handshake error", meaning events never reach the cloud — explaining why the local siren works but no push notifications arrive. The standard L1 fix (router + base station power-cycle) was already attempted and did not resolve it. Per the fault-code reference and historical case H-06, persistent E-503 with TLS handshake failure while the base is online indicates a cloud-channel/certificate issue that requires FAE escalation.
